message.reasoning_content:
We need to determine criminal liability. Facts: Defendant Wang refused to comply with civil judgment, failed to report assets, ignored enforcement notice, was fined, still didn't comply, later complied after. This is likely "拒不执行判决、裁定罪" (failure to execute judgment). Under Chinese criminal law, article 311 of Criminal Law: refusing to execute a civil judgment, etc. The offense is "拒不执行判决、裁定罪". The name without 罪? The rule says within [罪名]… output only plain offense names without appending the character “罪”. So we output "拒不执行判决、裁定". Also maybe "拒不报告财产状况"? But that is part of same offense. So single offense.

Thus final answer: [罪名]拒不执行判决、裁定<eoa>
